blockers.description: Tag, package/module, and rolling-manual version surfaces disagree.
Official document bodies and per-page content hashes are not retained.
Generated Sphinx/API documentation has not been reproduced from the exact tag.

catmap-exact-document-tree-inventory.title: CatMAP v0.4.1 documentation and tutorial tree metadata inventory

limitations: The exact tag-tree inventory does not establish a version-consistent rendered manual, native runtime, solver behavior, numerical validity, or mechanism acceptance.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

document-bodies-not-retained.description: Only exact Git path and object metadata are retained; documentation bodies remain external.

executable-tutorials-excluded.description: Executable Python, mkm, log, and pickle-like tutorial surfaces are retained only as path metadata and are never executed or deserialized.

rendered-build-not-replayed.description: The Sphinx/API build and generated reference surface have not been replayed.

version-surface-conflict.description: The v0.4.1 tag, setup/module version 0.3.1, and rolling manual label 0.2.79 conflict and are not normalized into one identity.
